newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian shares close mixed in low volume.
newsitem.headline: Russian shares close mixed in low volume.

text.p: Leading Russian shares closed mixed on Wednesday in low volumes and lethargic trading ahead of the New Year and Christmas holidays, traders said.
The Russian Trading System index of 24 shares rose by 0.6 percent to 186.02 on $11.44 million in volume.
"Today we only had isolated buy orders," said Nikolai Fomintsev, a trader from IATS Analyse.
Traders forecast the market would drift lower until the holidays.

The first Gazprom electronic trading session organised by the Federal Securities Corporation pushed down the share's offer prices on the RTS market, said Eduard Lanchev, a trader at Alfa-Rinaco brokerage.
Offers fell to $0.325 from $0.335 in the morning after news an average price of a Gazprom share at the electronic trading was 1,733.17 roubles, he said.

Lenenergo's report that its 9-month pre-tax profit was 152 billion roubles after 96.1 billion in the whole of 1995 failed to have an impact on the market, said Igor Rozhkov, chief trader from CS First Boston.
But the share rose to $0.415 from $0.379 as investors found the price good after a recent fall, he said.

Surgutneftegaz fell in a correction after Tuesday's rise prompted by Surgutneftegaz president that the company agreed to take steps to put right violations of securities law which arose as a result of last October's share issue, Rozhkov said.
The market was waiting for the International Monetary Fund's decision to pay Russia overdue tranches of its $10 billion loan, Lanchev said.
"Everything will depend on whether the IMF pays us the tranches," he said, adding that the new money will not come this year.
Nizhnevartovskneftegaz was the gainer of the day with prices rising to $6.15 from $5.00 on a single deal.
It is a very illiquid share traded with wide spread.
UES edged up to $0.0819 from $0.0815, Irkutskenergo edged down to $0.119 from $0.122, Yuganskneftegaz rose to $10.25 from $9.85 and GUM rose to $25.90 from $25.48.
